verdict.rationale: Latham states an emerging-companies financing practice that covers angel and seed investments and advises on hundreds of emerging-company financings each year. It also published a convertible-instrument form, the Automated Convertible Note generator built with ConsenSys, and its Emerging Companies Book of Jargon has a 'SAFE Investment' entry. LathamDrive also organizes resources under a Capital Raising stage. Missing for 10: a SAFE-specific explainer or SAFE form template, detailed pre-seed/seed convertible guidance beyond a glossary entry, and independent corroboration of SAFE deal experience.
